item.description: Officials say Hayden Panettiere was in cardiac arrest when paramedics responded to a 911 call on Sunday afternoon in the South Carolina home where she had been staying. “EMS personnel initiated advance cardiac life support measures, however, resuscitation efforts were unsuccessful,” the coroner said in a statement. The official cause of death is still under investigation. NBC’s Steve Patterson reports for TODAY.

item.description: Voters in California, Florida, Wyoming and Alaska are heading to the polls where candidates with the same name in the same race are sparking confusion and harsh accusations. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.
